Getting Started

A THOUGHTFUL START

Prepare the details that matter.

Use these steps to prepare for a setup discussion. The timing and services will be agreed based on your center’s needs.

01

Discuss requirements

Talk through your workflow, setup, and support arrangements.

02

Prepare your information

Gather your test catalog, prices, report formats, and existing data needs.

03

Configure your center

Plan staff roles, permissions, center branding, and equipment.

04

Review and plan go-live

Validate the workflow and agree on the next steps together.

YOUR SETUP CHECKLIST

Keep your preparation in one place.

Choose a priority for suggested items, then select what you want in your downloadable checklist.

The checklist stays on your device. Downloading it does not send an inquiry or book a demo.
